author: Tynvale
body:
New Top 5 Plays Host!

So as most of you may know already, I decided to take a break/leave from Avicus; and with that my Top 5 series has come to an end, or that's what you may think. After some thinking I thought the best thing to do was to hand off the series to another person in the community.

The person I chose, I think will do very well continuing this series and I know that most of you enjoy his videos already, so everyone congratulate the new host... Porky!

Make sure to subscribe to him: Click Here
His new email for you to send in clips is: AvicusTopPlays@gmail.com
